#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<long long> prev(n + 2, 0);
    prev[0] = 1;
    long long s = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n + 1; i++) {
        vector<long long> cur(n + 2, 0);
        int maxJ = min(n, 2 * n - i);
        cur[0] = prev[1] % MOD;
        for (int j = 1; j <= maxJ; j++) {
            cur[j] = (prev[j + 1] + prev[j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                s = (s + cur[j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        prev = move(cur);
    }

    cout << s << endl;
    return 0;
}
